request.style: English, female smooth jazz vocal, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, warm and confident mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Recalling your tears, I long to see you
So that I may be filled with joy
Reminded of your sincere faith
Lived first in your grandmother Lois
And your mother Eunice, I am convinced
It lives in you as well

[Pre-Chorus]
That is why I remind you
To fan into flame the gift of God
That is in you through the laying on
Of my hands upon your head

[Chorus]
For God did not give us a spirit of timidity
But of power and love and self-control
So do not be ashamed of the testimony
About our Lord, or of me his prisoner

[Verse]
Instead, share in suffering for the gospel
By the power of God who saved us
And called us with a holy calling
Not because of our works, but his own
Purpose and grace, given in Christ Jesus
Before time began, now revealed

[Chorus]
For God did not give us a spirit of timidity
But of power and love and self-control
So do not be ashamed of the testimony
About our Lord, or of me his prisoner

[Bridge]
Through the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ
Who abolished death and brought life to light
And immortality through the gospel
Now made clear to our eyes

[Chorus]
For God did not give us a spirit of timidity
But of power and love and self-control
So do not be ashamed of the testimony
About our Lord, or of me his prisoner

[Outro]
Power and love and self-control
The spirit of God in you
